rules.name: cash-refresh-16-definitions-and-health-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature, length(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) AS body_length, md5(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) AS body_md5, position('cbf_s3_lots' in p.prosrc) > 0 AS staged_body, position('cbf_s5_fxin' in p.prosrc) > 0 AS has_s5, pg_get_function_result(p.oid) LIKE '%original_lots numeric,%' AS lots_unbounded_numeric, pg_get_function_result(p.oid) LIKE '%original_lots numeric(18,4)%' AS lots_old_numeric_18_4 FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND p.proname = 'fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope' ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'overloads of fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope: ' || count(*) || ' (expected 1)' AS problem FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope' HAVING count(*) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'body md5 ' || md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) || ' length ' || length(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) || ' is not the double-lots body of Liquibase' || CASE WHEN md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'ed2d88a2d77b3b728742db3ba15aa57e' THEN ' (it is the OLDER full-premium body: typefix function not applied)' ELSE '' END FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope' AND md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) <> 'b821209631a7d0756192f210a530a726' UNION ALL SELECT 'result column original_lots is not unbounded numeric: ' || pg_get_function_result(oid) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope' AND pg_get_function_result(oid) NOT LIKE '%original_lots numeric,%'

SELECT v.viewname, md5(pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.' || v.viewname), true)) AS def_md5, length(pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.' || v.viewname), true)) AS def_length, position('latest_active_lot' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.' || v.viewname), true)) > 0 AS reads_latest_active_lot, position('deal_ticket_active_lots_view' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.' || v.viewname), true)) > 0 AS reads_active_lots_view, position('deal_active_lots_table' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.' || v.viewname), true)) > 0 AS reads_lots_history FROM (VALUES ('deal_ticket_active_lots_view'), ('deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'), ('valuation_financial_year_view'), ('helper_otc_multiplier_view'), ('curr_mult_view'), ('murex_nc_factor_view'), ('helper_invenio_product_code'), ('cash_balance_currency_mapping_view'), ('helper_cash_balance_report_view')) AS v(viewname) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'deal_ticket_active_lots_view does not exist' AS problem WHERE to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_active_lots_view') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_ticket_active_lots_view does not read latest_active_lot (PR 292 not applied or overwritten)' WHERE to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_active_lots_view') IS NOT NULL AND position('latest_active_lot' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_active_lots_view'), true)) = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view does not exist' WHERE to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view') IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view reads neither deal_ticket_active_lots_view nor latest_active_lot' WHERE to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view') IS NOT NULL AND position('deal_ticket_active_lots_view' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'), true)) = 0 AND position('latest_active_lot' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'), true)) = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view lost the XOGA-65 fixing scope (og2, ogp, rba, rbc, usg)' WHERE to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view') IS NOT NULL AND position('''og2''' in pg_get_viewdef(to_regclass('opera.deal_ticket_table_with_fy_premium_view'), true)) = 0

SELECT c.relname AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname = 'cloned_deal_ticket_table' AND a.attname IN ('premium', 'premium_1', 'original_lots', 'active_lots', 'netted_lots', 'lots_to_be_netted', 'price_1', 'price_2') AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attname

SELECT c.relname || '.' || a.attname || ' is ' || format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) || ' (expected double precision after the typefix)' AS problem FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname = 'cloned_deal_ticket_table' AND a.attname IN ('premium', 'original_lots', 'active_lots', 'netted_lots') AND NOT a.attisdropped AND format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) <> 'double precision'

SELECT orderexecuted, id, exectype, dateexecuted FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id LIKE 'create-fn-cash-balance-report%' OR id LIKE '%typefix%' OR id LIKE '%active-lots-view%' OR id LIKE '%fy-premium-view%' OR id LIKE '%latest-active-lot%' OR id LIKE '%latest_active_lot%' ORDER BY orderexecuted

SELECT s.relname, s.n_live_tup, s.n_dead_tup, s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze, s.last_vacuum, s.last_autovacuum, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(s.relid)) AS total_size FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'cloned_security_info_table', 'deal_active_lots_table', 'latest_active_lot', 'deal_ticket_table', 'fixing_table', 'premium_fy_table', 'financial_year_table', 'valuation_date_table', 'futures_price_table', 'underlying_list_table', 'product_master_table', 'underlying_settle_value_table', 'netting_id_table', 'rms_premium_paid_table', 'security_info_table', 'security_last_actual_value_table', 'security_settlement_value_table', 'underlying_actual_value_table') ORDER BY s.relname

SELECT s.relname || ': analysed ' || coalesce(greatest(s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze)::text, 'never') || ' (before the typefix of 11 Nov)' AS problem FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'option_expiry_deals_table', 'latest_active_lot', 'cloned_security_info_table') AND coalesce(greatest(s.last_analyze, s.last_autoanalyze), timestamp '1970-01-01') < :analyzedAfter UNION ALL SELECT s.relname || ': ' || s.n_dead_tup || ' dead tuples against ' || s.n_live_tup || ' live (vacuum needed)' FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.schemaname = 'opera' AND s.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'latest_active_lot', 'premium_fy_table', 'fixing_table', 'deal_active_lots_table') AND s.n_dead_tup > greatest(10000, 0.1 * s.n_live_tup)

SELECT i.tablename, i.indexname, x.indisvalid, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS index_size, i.indexdef FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.tablename IN ('latest_active_lot', 'cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'premium_fy_table', 'fixing_table', 'deal_active_lots_table') ORDER BY i.tablename, i.indexname

SELECT 'latest_active_lot has no valid index on (tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id)' AS problem WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.tablename = 'latest_active_lot' AND x.indisvalid AND i.indexdef LIKE '%(tenant_id, business_unit, trade_id)%') UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket_table has no valid index that starts with tenant_id and business_unit' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND i.tablename = 'cloned_deal_ticket_table' AND x.indisvalid AND i.indexdef LIKE '%(tenant_id, business_unit%') UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid index ' || i.indexname || ' on ' || i.tablename FROM pg_indexes i JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = i.indexname AND c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace JOIN pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE i.schemaname = 'opera' AND NOT x.indisvalid AND i.tablename IN ('latest_active_lot', 'cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'premium_fy_table', 'fixing_table', 'deal_active_lots_table')

expect.reason: live function body equals the double-lots body in Liquibase
the two changed views carry the PR 292 definitions
lots and premium are double precision after the typefix
tables analysed after the typefix, no heavy dead tuple load
the hot tables kept their tenant-leading indexes
